faqSection.title: Find your answers
faqSection.description: Quick answers about our solutions and how we help your team.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to implement AI in my company?
items.answer: No. We handle the full development and integration. Your team only needs to use the final solution, which we design to be as simple as possible.

items.question: Do you provide on-site consulting at the company?
items.answer: Yes. We visit client facilities to analyze internal processes in person and identify bottlenecks and automation opportunities that are hard to spot remotely.

items.question: Can you build an online store for my retail business or restaurant?
items.answer: Yes. We implement online ordering systems and websites for shops and restaurants with a very simple control panel for non-technical teams.

items.question: Do your solutions work with any ERP or system?
items.answer: Yes. We work with SAP, Dynamics AX, Holded, Sage and any system with an API or database access.

items.question: How long does implementation take?
items.answer: An online store for a local business in 1-2 weeks. A simple automation in about 2 weeks. A full AI agent with ERP integration in 4 to 8 weeks.

items.question: Do you issue VAT invoices?
items.answer: Yes. We are registered freelancers in Spain and fully tax compliant. We issue VAT invoices and operate with companies across Europe with intra-community VAT numbers.

aboutPage.title: Adimen Intelligence Technologies
aboutPage.subtitle: Born in Elgoibar
aboutPage.companyDescription: We are a company dedicated to the development, design, programming, operation and commercialization of software, applications and technological platforms based on artificial intelligence (AI).
aboutPage.companyDescription2: Born in Elgoibar, a benchmark town in the Basque industry, always committed to innovation and new trends.
aboutPage.diagramTitle: An AI ecosystem serving the Basque fabric
aboutPage.diagramSubtitle: Each ring stands for a pillar of our work: technology, people, sustainability and territory.
aboutPage.missionText: Help organizations by creating intelligent technological ecosystems that transform data into decisions and manual processes into automatic value flows, favoring energy transition and sustainability, promoting Basque language and making our staff enjoy their work while contributing to the improvement of our surroundings.
aboutPage.visionText: To be a benchmark in the Basque Country for digital transformation solutions through applied AI, automation and high-impact data analysis.
aboutPage.valuesTitle: Four principles that guide every project
aboutPage.valuesSubtitle: We build technology with judgement, close to people and committed to the environment.
aboutPage.value1Text: We apply AI and automation only where they bring real value, not because it is trendy.
aboutPage.value2Text: On-site support, active listening and a firm commitment to Basque language and the local fabric.
aboutPage.value3Text: Solid engineering, secure integrations and ongoing support so your team moves without friction.
aboutPage.value4Text: Every project is measured by its return: hours saved, better decisions and sustained growth.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From Elgoibar to the world, with Basque roots
aboutPage.storyP1: We were born in Elgoibar, a town with a long industrial tradition and a nonconformist spirit that matches the way we understand technology: as a tool at the service of people, not an end in itself.
aboutPage.storyP2: Today we help companies across the Basque Country and northern Spain adopt artificial intelligence, automate their operations and build digital platforms that scale with their business. We do it in Spanish and Basque, with the closeness of those who share territory and culture.
